newsitem.title: UK: Premier Farnell says market view unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Premier Farnell says market view unchanged.

text.p: Electronic components distributor Premier Farnell Plc said on Monday it did not expect to see a change in weak market conditions during the rest of this year.

The Anglo-U.S. operator said there had been a weak market for electronic components, coupled with sluggish economic conditions particularly in continental Europe, which hurt its distribution business in the first half.
Premier Farnell's pretax profita fell to 56.1 million stg for the six months ended July 28, compared to 71.3 million stg in the same period a year earlier.
The results fell below analysts' forecasts, which ranged from 57.5 million stg to 63.1 million, with a consensus estimate of 61.6 million stg.
"The group does not believe there is any fundamental reason to expect any major changes in market conditions for the remainder of the year," Premier Farnell said in a statement.
The company, which merged with U.S. group Premier Industrial Corp earlier this year, added that all of its sales expansion projects are on schedule.
The company said they will begin to make a contribution in the fourth quarter.
